problem_text:
A logistics company needs to schedule 5 delivery routes through 5 different distribution centers.

Each route consists of a sequence of handling stages represented as pairs (Center, Duration),
where each pair specifies the distribution center where the stage must occur and the time required for handling.
The order of pairs indicates the required sequence in which the stages must be completed.

Route details:
* R1 requires the sequence: (DC5, 5) → (DC4, 1) → (DC2, 1) → (DC1, 5) → (DC3, 7)
* R2 requires the sequence: (DC5, 6) → (DC4, 5) → (DC2, 4) → (DC1, 10) → (DC3, 2)
* R3 requires the sequence: (DC1, 2) → (DC5, 9) → (DC2, 4) → (DC3, 3) → (DC4, 2)
* R4 requires the sequence: (DC4, 9) → (DC3, 2) → (DC2, 7) → (DC1, 9) → (DC5, 7)
* R5 requires the sequence: (DC3, 3) → (DC5, 2) → (DC2, 2) → (DC4, 7) → (DC1, 7)

Each handling stage must proceed without interruption once it begins,
and each distribution center can only accommodate one delivery route's stage at a time.
The objective is to determine the processing sequence of all stages at the distribution centers
so that the total completion time for all delivery routes is minimized.
